ImportDataSrc.clientToken: Ensures idempotency of the API call
ImportDataSrc.bucket: The object storage bucket of the data source (currently only buckets in the same region are supported)
ImportDataSrc.otherAccount: Whether the bucket belongs to another account. If true, you must provide an AK/SK with read-write permission on the import bucket. Default is false; required when storageType is not BOS. Passing false or omitting it is implicitly normalized to true
ImportDataSrc.storageType: Object storage type. Allowed values: BOS (default, for backward compatibility) / OSS; any other value returns the error Invalid storageType. Omitting it defaults to BOS, keeping the semantics of existing requests unchanged
ImportDataSrc.bucketEndpoint:
The endpoint of the object storage service.
Required when storageType is not BOS.
Optional when storageType is BOS: if provided, the given value is used; if omitted, the backend automatically derives it from the region.
ImportDataSrc.bucketAK: Required when otherAccount is true; no encryption needed
ImportDataSrc.bucketSK: Required when otherAccount is true; must be encrypted using the secret key corresponding to request header x-bce-accesskey. Refer to the Password Encryption Transmission Specification and the aes128_encrypt_16char_key() function in bce-python-sdk
ImportDataSrc.bucketStsToken: Effective when otherAccount is true; no encryption needed
ImportDataSrc.dirPrefix: Directory prefix of the BOS bucket. Default: /. For example, to import all objects under bos:/bucket_name/model_data/2025/, set dirPrefix to /model_data/2025/
ImportDataSrc.syncMetaOnImport: Whether to synchronize metadata immediately when the data source is imported. Default is true
ImportDataSrc.keepSymlink: Whether to preserve symbolic links. Preserving symlinks reduces data source import efficiency and the efficiency of subsequent incremental metadata synchronization. Default is false
ImportDataSrc.authGroupId: Permission group ID; the default permission group ID is AG-RAPIDFS_DEFAULT_AUTHGROUP_ID
ImportDataSrc.mountServiceBindings:
The list of mount services to bind to the data source. For the element type, see the data type MountServiceBinding.
Omitted or empty list: no mount service is bound.
Non-empty list: all elements are validated together at request time and accepted only if all pass; each is bound one by one after the data source is imported successfully.
The same mountServiceId cannot appear more than once.
If the import fails, no binding is performed, and any occupied mount paths are released accordingly
ImportDataSrc.mountServiceBindings.mountServiceId: Mount service ID. Always returned in responses; optional in requests, where omitting it uses the default mount service MNTSVC-RAPIDFS_DEFAULT_ID
ImportDataSrc.mountServiceBindings.mountServiceName: Mount service name. Always returned in responses; read-only in requests, where any provided value is ignored
ImportDataSrc.mountServiceBindings.dataSrcId: Unique ID of the data source. Always returned in responses; read-only in requests, where the value is determined by the data source the request belongs to and any provided value is ignored
ImportDataSrc.mountServiceBindings.dataSrcName: Data source name. Always returned in responses; read-only in requests, where any provided value is ignored
ImportDataSrc.mountServiceBindings.logicalMountPath:
The first-level directory name of the data source within this mount service, such as aa-vvd-gh. Only one level is allowed; nesting is not permitted. Must comply with POSIX filename rules: cannot be empty, cannot contain / or the null character (NUL), cannot be . or .., and cannot exceed 255 bytes.
Must be unique within the same mount service, with the uniqueness check covering paths that are being bound or changed
ImportDataSrc.mountServiceBindings.status:
Binding status. Always returned in responses; read-only in requests, where any provided value is ignored. Enum values:
BINDING (binding in progress, including waiting for the data source import to complete)
BOUND (bound, accessible via the mount address)
BIND_FAILED (binding failed)
UNBINDING (unbinding in progress)
UNBIND_FAILED (unbinding failed)
ImportDataSrc.quotaMiB: Capacity quota for the data source, representing the maximum available capacity; cannot exceed the total cache capacity of the instance
